limitations: Select a physical NVML GPU UUID, set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and ODS_GPU_UUID to that UUID, and use logical cuda:0.
The matching native runtime must qualify CUDA UUID to Vulkan UUID mapping; no fallback to an unmasked or unreserved GPU is permitted.
Selected GPUs have three idle readings and at least 16GiB free. This is not an exclusive-device reservation.
An optional auxiliary graphics GPU is separately reserved and excluded from primary assignments; only known per-PID pure-G footprints up to 8 MiB are allowed there.
The parent samples compute and graphics contexts attributed to its child PID tree or process group; short-lived contexts can fall between samples.
No system-wide file cache is purged. Calibration is a preflight observation, not a guaranteed concurrent capacity.

limitations: This script never edits experiment summaries or qualification flags and never retries a run.
Pairing mismatch prevents exact paired comparisons; it is not automatically a data-system failure.
GPU context evidence is periodically sampled and does not prove no short-lived foreign-device context existed.
Tensor values/boundary validity are not reconstructed from aggregate logs; retained source hashes and the original validator remain required.
Missing live artifacts are pending, not passed; finalized missing evidence remains unknown or failed.
